    How much do Siena basketball coaches make?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Siena College men’s basketball coach Gerry McNamara, hired in March 2024, is estimated to have a salary in the range of
    $400,000 to $600,000 annually. This is typical for a head coach in the Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference (MAAC), where successful coaches generally earn in the mid-six-figure range, though exact contract figures are not publicly disclosed. 
    • Context: McNamara replaced former coach Carmen Maciariello, who was paid $362,450 in 2021-22 plus additional compensation, according to reports from Syracuse.com.
    • Comparison: While a mid-major coach, McNamara’s compensation is significantly less than high-major counterparts like Duke’s Jon Scheyer, who earns an estimated $7–8 million annually, as reported by MSN and Sporting News.
    • Assistant Coach Salaries:
      For context, assistant basketball coaching positions at Siena have shown salaries closer to $62,000, according to information on Glassdoor.
